Diagnostic data stays on your device

• Vehicle diagnostic data (trouble codes, data logs, trips, vehicle info) is stored only on this device and is never uploaded to any server.
• This app does not collect personal data and does not require an internet connection for full diagnostics.
• If AI diagnosis is enabled, your codes and data are sent to the AI service you configure only when you tap "Analyze".
• Clearing app data or uninstalling permanently deletes local diagnostic records.

Check spark plug gap and carbon, ignition coil and HT leads first; single-cylinder misfire usually comes with vibration and weak acceleration.
Check injectors for blockage, fuel pump pressure and fuel filter; a dirty air filter causes rich mixture and higher fuel use.
Stop and cool down immediately; check coolant level, water pump and fan. Riding while overheating can burn the head gasket.
Check intake hoses for cracks/leaks, air filter and throttle body carbon; clean and re-learn idle afterwards.
Check O2 sensor and catalytic converter; an aging O2 sensor raises fuel use and emissions — check it first when exhaust smells odd.
Measure battery voltage at idle (normal 13.5–14.5V); a faulty rectifier or stator causes hard starts and electrical instability.
Check chain tension and lube, and clutch slip (RPM rising without acceleration); a loose chain causes noise and skipping.
Check pad wear and disc warping; noise often comes from wear indicators or debris in the disc — inspect immediately.
